note: Free-standing scenery for the village landscape (apps/web/src/art/landscape.tsx), not map tiles. Each file's viewBox origin (0,0) is the foot point: the middle of the ground footprint the piece sits on. The base is a flattened isometric ellipse (hills ry = 0.3 rx). Lit from the top left: light top-left, mid body, dark right. Stroke #2B211C 1.4-1.9. Plain paths only (no ids, clips or gradients) so several can be inlined in one SVG. App copies live in apps/web/src/art/landscape-sprites/.

hill-1.shape: long low ridge with a footpath

hill-2.shape: round knoll with a pine and bushes

hill-3.shape: double hump with pines in the saddle

rocks-2.shape: taller cluster with a small pine
